combined_source_extraction.country: United States, Canada, Netherlands, Sweden, Finland, Australia
combined_source_extraction.ethnicity_supporting_text: The Pooling Project of Prospective Studies of Diet and Cancer (referred to hereafter as the Pooling Project) is an international consortium of cohort studies whose goal is to analyze diet and cancer associations ( 19 ).

cases.excerpt: A total of 1478 incident cases of renal cell cancer were identified (709 in women and 769 in men).

confidence_interval.excerpt: For example, the pooled multivariable RR for the highest vs the lowest quintile of total fat intake was 1.10 (95% CI = 0.92 to 1.32; P trend = .31).

design.excerpt: We conducted a pooled analysis of 13 prospective studies

effect_size.excerpt: By comparison, the pooled multivariable RR for the highest vs the lowest quintile of total fat intake was 1.10 (95% CI = 0.92 to 1.32; P trend = .31) and of total protein intake was 1.06 (95% CI = 0.89 to 1.26; P trend = .37). Intakes of red meat, processed meat, poultry, or seafood were not associated with the risk of renal cell cancer.
